主要内容: On March 14, 2018, Joseph R. Tomkinson resigned as Chairman and CEO of Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc., effective July 31, 2018. He will remain a director. George A. Mangiaracina was appointed President, having served as Executive Vice President since 2015. Mangiaracina, 53, was expected to become CEO upon Tomkinson’s departure. He has over 20 years of experience in securities and mortgage banking, including roles at UBS and Deutsche Bank. He was involved in the 2015 acquisition and management of IMH’s CashCall Mortgage platform. The text outlines his employment terms, including compensation upon termination, death, or disability. Rian Furey was appointed Chief Operating Officer. The content focuses on corporate governance and executive compensation, with no reference to stock price movements or market predictions. There are no family relationships or transactions requiring disclosure under Regulation S-K.
